description: Reference packet for the source-bound super-Tannakian matter lift (issue #314). The current algebra is strictly upstream through the hash-pinned #566 packet, whose #599 response is source-bound by the exact target-blind carrier impulse/readback protocol. BLOCK-DETERMINANT-BALANCE derives the primitive charge pair up to charge conjugation; the exhaustive 1024-subset anomaly scan selects the unordered conjugate rank-fifteen pair with the fermionic-parity grading as an output; and the hash-pinned measured spin statistics artifact supplies the non-split transport double cover whose central -1 is the unique source implementation of that grading, forcing the Spin/odd-Weyl typing. The statistics and category contracts below are validated against those derivations. Scalar charge and channel compatibility are exact only conditional on the declared weak-doublet scalar content; scalar existence and economy are owned by issue #609.

exterior_matter_contract.note: the charge pair must lie in the derived conjugate primitive pair and the declared channels must match the exact compatibility calculation. One weak-block scalar is a branch assumption; existence, multiplicity, and no-extra-scalar economy are not derived.

statistics_contract.note: matter states are built from anticommuting auxiliary CAR generators; the abelian bosonic coefficient records of the screen lane are a different typed object

spin_lift.note: the kernel-block action must be lifted through a genuine double cover; a split lift is rejected against the derived unique-involution witness

category_contract.note: the verifier derives the unordered conjugate pair consisting of the even-minus-vacuum and odd-minus-top rank-fifteen projectors; neither representative is physically preferred

kernel_emission_contract.note: the common action kernel on every realized matter tensor is emitted as data for the downstream global-form descent; the final quotient is not chosen here

mar_class.note: this packet proves the declared class nonempty by realization; uniqueness stays in the MAR lane
